description: This file defines a React functional component 'UIAccessControlForm' in TypeScript that implements a form for configuring UI access control settings. It interacts with backend APIs to load and save settings, manages form state, and provides UI elements for user interaction.

methods.name: loadUIAccessSettings
methods.description: Asynchronously loads existing SSO settings and updates form fields.

methods.name: handleUIAccessSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the form to update UI access control settings via API.
